title: CamChoreo: Benchmarking Temporally Grounded Compositional Camera Motion Understanding for Vision Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.10932v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Understanding camera motion is fundamental to video perception, with applications in spatial intelligence and controllable video generation. Existing camera motion evaluations typically assign labels to entire clips, overlooking within-shot changes and simultaneous movements. We therefore formulate camera motion understanding as temporally grounded, compositional recognition, requiring models to localize motion-consistent intervals and identify all active movements. We introduce CamChoreo, the first benchmark for this task, comprising 4,229 diverse single-shot clips with expert temporal annotations using 20 direction-aware labels. Nearly half of its segments contain compound camera motion. We also construct a separate training corpus of approximately 43K clips with the same annotation format. translated_title: CamChoreo：面向视觉语言模型的时间定位组合式相机运动理解基准
translated_abstract: 理解相机运动是视频感知的基础，在空间智能和可控视频生成中有着广泛应用。现有的相机运动评估通常为整个视频片段分配标签，忽略了镜头内部的变化以及同时发生的多种运动。因此，我们将相机运动理解形式化为时间定位的组合式识别任务，要求模型定位运动一致的区间并识别所有正在发生的运动。我们提出了CamChoreo，这是该任务的首个基准，包含4,229个多样化的单镜头视频片段，采用20个方向感知标签进行专家时间标注，其中近一半的片段包含复合相机运动。我们还构建了一个采用相同标注格式、约43K片段的独立训练语料库。在CamChoreo上，基于该语料库进行监督微调（SFT）后，4B/8B骨干模型分别达到62.1/64.1的微平均F1分数，优于先进的闭源（模型）。
tldr: 提出了首个时间定位组合式相机运动理解基准CamChoreo，包含4,229个专家标注的单镜头片段及约43K规模的训练语料，微调后的视觉语言模型在该任务上显著优于先进的闭源模型。
en_tdlr: CamChoreo is introduced as the first benchmark for temporally grounded compositional camera motion understanding, featuring 4,229 expert-annotated single-shot clips and a ~43K training corpus, on which fine-tuned vision language models outperform advanced closed-source models.
